title: Seared {p} with {v}
steps: Take the {p} out of the fridge 30 minutes ahead, pat very dry and season well with the {spice} and salt.

Sear in a very hot, lightly oiled pan 3 to 4 minutes a side for a 1-inch cut, then check the thickest part with a thermometer. The USDA safe minimum for steak is 145°F / 63°C. A lower doneness is your choice and carries more risk.
Rest the {p} 3 to 5 minutes on a clean plate while you cook the {v} in the same pan.
Slice against the grain and serve with the {s} and the {sauce}.
tip: Make the veg half the plate, keep the steak to a palm-size portion and use mustard or herbs instead of a butter sauce.
